articles.title: New REDUCE-IT® Analysis Presented at the European Atherosclerosis Society (EAS) Congress 2026 Suggests Risk-Weighted ApoB May Improve Identification of Residual Cardiovascular Risk in Statin-Treated Patients with Hypertriglyceridemia
